instructions.mission: Synthesize multi-LLM code review findings and apply fixes
instructions.constraints: - Do NOT perform web searches or web fetches. Work only from provided files and code. - Be concise. Focus on applying fixes, not verbose analysis.

steps.step: Cross-reference findings from all code reviewers. Verify validity of each finding by examining the actual code. Note areas of consensus and disagreement.
Check each finding against the actual codebase. Document false positives with explanation.
Order fixes: Critical > High > Medium > Low. Group related fixes together.
Apply validated fixes using Edit tool. After each group of fixes, run the tests covering the files that group touched. Revert if tests break.
Only refactor files already modified by applied fixes. Keep refactoring scope minimal and targeted.

Detect project toolchain from build system files (package.json, pyproject.toml, pom.xml, build.gradle, Cargo.toml, Makefile) and verify the surface you changed.
You MUST execute these commands yourself. Reporting "requires manual run", or deferring execution to a later stage, is not verification — it is how broken code reaches a green review.
1. Lint/Type Check: run the detected lint and typecheck commands 2. Build: verify the project still builds 3. Tests: run the tests covering the files you touched — the tests for this task and the tests that exercise the code paths those files changed. Scope the run to that surface; the deterministic quality gate phase owns the whole-suite verdict and runs it immediately after this phase. 4. If a failure was caused by an applied fix: revert that fix, re-run
Record all verification results, including the scope you ran, for the synthesis report.

Update the story file (provided in context as story_file) based on the synthesis verdict: - APPROVED/EXEMPLARY with no unfixed CRITICAL issues: Set status to "done" - MAJOR REWORK or REJECT or CRITICAL issues remain: Set status to "in-progress"
Append review summary under "## Senior Developer Review (AI)" in the story file.

Create report and save it to {report_dir}/{story_key}-code-review-synthesis.md
Report must include: - Applied fixes with before/after - Rejected findings with rationale - Reverted fixes with regression details (if any) - Runtime verification results (Lint, Type Check, Build, Tests: Pass/Fail) and the test scope that was actually executed - Final quality assessment
IMPORTANT: Create the {report_dir} directory if it does not exist. Do NOT write reports to any other location.
